title: E-FRC-0277: the slot frame is not the Higgs on the present rule, fail as derived: SU(2)+'s center acts on the dock...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0277 in the gauge arena: the slot frame is not the Higgs on the present rule, fail as derived: SU(2)+'s center acts on the dock as 1 x (-J), moving no slot, and no element of W(F4) acts that way (0 of 1,152; the rule's -I is the slot reversal times 1 on the register); the dock's slot quaternion is odd under -I and even under the SU(2)+ center, and its full-sea expectation is 0; the center is exactly the register part of -I's spinor lift (L(-vol) = -J), so a frame that carried SU(2)+ charge needs the spinor -I to be the rule's own, a new piece.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
